# apple_subscription_promotional_offers (Data Source)

Lists the promotional offers of an auto-renewable subscription.

An offer made in App Store Connect is known by its offer code, which is what the app holds; this is how a configuration finds its Apple ID, either to import it into `apple_subscription_promotional_offer` or to hand the codes to whatever signs offers on the app's server. Apple publishes no top-level collection of offers, so the listing is scoped to one subscription. Prices are not listed: they are a separate collection per offer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_apps" "example" {
  bundle_id = "com.example.app"
}

data "apple_subscription_groups" "premium" {
  app_id = data.apple_apps.example.apps[0].id
}

data "apple_subscriptions" "pro_monthly" {
  group_id           = data.apple_subscription_groups.premium.subscription_groups[0].id
  product_id_pattern = "^com\\.example\\.app\\.pro\\.monthly$"
}

# Every promotional offer on the subscription, including ones made by hand in
# App Store Connect.
data "apple_subscription_promotional_offers" "pro_monthly" {
  subscription_id = data.apple_subscriptions.pro_monthly.subscriptions[0].id
}

# One offer, found by the code the app requests it with.
data "apple_subscription_promotional_offers" "win_back" {
  subscription_id = data.apple_subscriptions.pro_monthly.subscriptions[0].id
  offer_code      = "winback_half_3m"
}

output "offer_codes" {
  value = [for offer in data.apple_subscription_promotional_offers.pro_monthly.promotional_offers : offer.offer_code]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subscription_id` (String) The ID of the subscription whose promotional offers to list.

### Optional

- `offer_code` (String) Return only the offer with exactly this offer code. Applied in memory: Apple publishes no offer code filter.

### Read-Only

- `filtered_count` (Number) Number of offers remaining after the filter.
- `promotional_offers` (Attributes List) The promotional offers matching the filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--promotional_offers))
- `total_count` (Number) Number of offers the subscription has, before the filter.

<a id="nestedatt--promotional_offers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `promotional_offers`

Read-Only:

- `duration` (String) The length of one offer period: `THREE_DAYS`, `ONE_WEEK`, `TWO_WEEKS`, `ONE_MONTH`, `TWO_MONTHS`, `THREE_MONTHS`, `SIX_MONTHS` or `ONE_YEAR`.
- `id` (String) The Apple-generated identifier of the offer.
- `name` (String) The offer's reference name, internal to App Store Connect.
- `number_of_periods` (Number) How many `duration` periods the offer lasts.
- `offer_code` (String) The identifier the app passes to the App Store to request the offer.
- `offer_mode` (String) How the customer pays during the offer: `PAY_AS_YOU_GO`, `PAY_UP_FRONT` or `FREE_TRIAL`.
- `target_subscription_plan_type` (String) Which plan the offer applies to, `MONTHLY` or `UPFRONT`, when Apple reports one.
